prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset: square photorealistic catalog photograph of a very dry, bureaucratic Japanese property title deed parody for the fictional shop 伊見内商会.
Subject: ONE portrait sheet of slightly aged pale ivory-gray paper, nearly front facing, fully visible with generous dark navy surroundings on a dark charcoal desk. The actual paper fills central 80% of square image, realistic paper fibers, light wrinkles, faint creases, subdued neutral desk lighting.
Design: extremely serious Japanese real estate ownership deed / old legal document aesthetic. Monochrome charcoal black ink, fine repeating geometric security border, rectangular ruled heading, administrative ruled form fields, traditional Japanese Mincho type, small vertical Japanese text columns. NO gold, medals, laurels, ribbons, ornamental certificate flourishes. At top use a small simple abstract square diamond seal belonging to a FICTIONAL SHOP, NOT government crest or paulownia emblem. One small muted red rectangular fictional company stamp at lower left.
Main large title verbatim "何もしない権利書". Above it small "伊見内商会". Under it "[ 不作為権 設定 ]". Form labels "権利者　名もなき浪費家 様", "対象　何もしない時間", "効力　気持ちの上のみ", "発行者　伊見内商会". A few short vertical body columns reading "本書は何もしないことを認めるものです。" and "使用期限はございません。". Bottom clearly visible small disclaimer "架空の権利書・法的効力はありません".
Make it visually sober, rigid, dense and plausibly official in layout, with readable faithful Japanese, but clearly a humorous fictional shop document. No real government insignia, actual registry office names, signature, QR code, barcode, real personal data, watermark, UI overlays, hands, people, frame or other objects. No copy of any actual deed. Restrained product photography matching a dark navy luxury store. Entire rectangular paper visible with margins.
